message.content: The film most frequently cited as the standout of 2020 is **“Parasite”** (2019‑release). It swept the major awards—winning Best Picture at the 92nd Academy Awards, Best International Feature Film, and several other Oscars—while also topping critics’ year‑end lists and receiving universal praise for its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. Its impact on both audiences and the industry made it the definitive “best movie” of that year for many viewers and critics alike.
